source: a true 3D boss-battle arena (not a 2D, top-down, or UI/screen-based game): the player stands in a 3D arena with a first-person or over-the-shoulder camera and fights ONE large, unique boss monster that you generate as a single detailed, custom 3D model from a text description of a fearsome creature. The player attacks the boss with a ranged weapon to deplete a visible boss health bar while the boss moves around the arena and attacks back, damaging the player; defeating the boss triggers a clear victory state. The boss must be a distinctive generated 3D mesh creature, not an assembly of plain primitive blocks and not a flat 2D sprite or GUI image. Do not ask any clarifying questions. Make any reasonable creative decisions yourself and build the complete, playable game now.
blob:
## Clarifications resolved
- [agent_inferred] scale — Q: How large should the boss arena be? A: Use a medium arena with enough open ground for one large boss and sustained ranged movement.
- [agent_inferred] boundary — Q: Should the fight use one floor or multiple vertical levels? A: Use one clearly bounded, single-level floor with no stacked play surfaces.

## Enriched image prompt
Build a true three-dimensional boss-battle arena as one medium, clearly bounded, single-level space. Keep a broad central floor open for one large unique boss creature to move and attack while leaving enough perimeter room for the player to circle and fight at range. Set one screened player arrival position at the arena edge and one distinct boss entry position across the floor. The boss is a single detailed custom 3D mesh with a fearsome, distinctive silhouette, never a primitive-block assembly or flat sprite; no unsupported anatomy or setting details are invented. Use neutral environment dressing because the author did not specify a visual theme.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Action. The ranged weapon is a combat mechanic inside a boss-raid arena rather than a lane-based Shooter map.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, expressed as one flat collision-clean boss arena with clear edges and open circling room. The matched preset is Boss Raid, with its unrequested environmental hazards and destructible cover dropped.

## Config requirements
Draw the visible half of `spawn-protected` as one screened player arrival recess at the arena edge. No hazards, breakable cover, buildings, terrain relief, or other image-config options were requested.

## Layout requirements
Place one `spawn-protected` SpawnZone inside the screened edge recess, facing the central floor. Place one `spawner-npc` Spawner at the opposite side for exactly one large custom boss. The health bar, damage exchange, ranged weapon behavior, camera, and victory state are mechanics or UI and do not add map placements.

## Layout components
The concrete build is one medium single-level arena with a broad open central combat zone, a clearly enclosed perimeter, one screened player arrival recess, and one opposite boss entry point. Keep the floor free of minor collision clutter so a large creature and a circling player can move continuously. Compose the arena so its complete boundary, open combat floor, player start, and boss origin remain visible. The creature model is one actor asset rather than environmental geometry.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the arena is a simple bounded floor whose visual dressing can lead without risking invalid gameplay topology. The author's rejection of a top-down game concerns the gameplay camera, not this generation order.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium because the arena must preserve open ranged-combat distance around one large boss while keeping the player start and boss origin legible. The visual theme is unspecified, so use neutral environment dressing rather than inventing a setting. The pipeline uses `P0`: one grounded arena surface needs no overhang, interior transition, separate map, or procedural topology.
